headline: Carbacid Expands Solar Capacity to Offset Grid Costs in Kenya
summary: Nairobi-listed Carbacid stated that solar power covered about 27% of its electricity needs in 2025/26 and announced plans for more panels and a battery system to hedge against tariff rises.
why: Industrial energy self-generation helps companies mitigate the impact of volatile grid electricity tariffs on operating margins.

impacts.name: Carbacid Investments
impacts.why: The Nairobi-listed company is investing in solar capacity to hedge against operational costs.
